The first Trump administration stated that these practices may contribute to the US–China trade deficit, and that the Chinese government requires the transfer of American technology to China. In response to the trade measures, CCP general [withheld]ary Xi Jinping's administration accused the Trump administration of engaging in nationalist protectionism and took retaliatory action. Following the trade war's escalation through 2019, the two sides reached a tense phase-one agreement in January 2020. However, because of a temporary collapse in goods trade around the globe during the COVID-19 pandemic together with a short recession diminished the chance of meeting the target, China failed to buy the $200 billion worth of additional imports specified. By Alan Simmons Published: Sep 22 2026, 4:44 AM EDT Share on Facebook Share on Twitter Share on LinkedIn Share on Reddit Share on Flipboard Share on Pocket FILE: A Chatham Islands black robin, or karure, wearing an identification band on its leg, perches on a branch in New Zealand's Chatham Islands on July 27, 2015. The critically threatened species, reduced to five birds in 1980, was voted New Zealand's 2026 Bird of the Year with a record 105,000 people casting ballots. Peter de Lange/Wikimedia Commons CC0 1.0 While much of the world spent the weekend counting ballots in rather weightier contests, New Zealanders turned out in record numbers for an election of their own — and handed victory to a small, entirely black songbird that 46 years ago was five individuals away from vanishing from the Earth. The karure, or Chatham Islands black robin, was crowned New Zealand's 2026 Bird of the Year on Monday, finishing atop the field with 26,610 votes, according to Forest & Bird, the independent conservation organization that runs the annual competition. The robin beat out two celebrated former champions — the kākāpō, the world's heaviest flightless parrot, which had led early voting, and the kārearea, New Zealand's native falcon — into second and third place. The turnout was itself a story.
